plan.notes: Source is AUM's institution-published '4-Year Plan' for Exercise Science, PT (Physical Therapy) Track (file dated 2-3-23 via URL, currently published on aum.edu) — a sample term-by-term schedule including Summer semesters, seeded per the sample-schedule rule. Flight plan header reads 'Major: Kinesiology Degree: Exercise Science (PT Track)'. Generic slots (MATH choice, FINE ARTS, HISTORY, ENGL LIT CORE, HIST or ENGL LIT CORE, Area II or IV Elective, PHED Activity Course) are choice:true with the flight plan's own wording; specific courses are not assigned by the source. '3|1' lecture|lab pairs are seeded as a single slot at the combined credit total. The MATH slot is variable: 'MATH 1120 or MATH 1150, 3 or 4' credits; seeded at base 3 as choice:true. MATH 1550 (2 cr) is conditional — required only if MATH 1120 was taken; seeded as choice:true with that note. Credit-sum note: the plan as published sums to 127 credits on the MATH 1120 path (15+16+4+16+15+13+14+12+13+9) or 126 on the MATH 1150 path; no degree total is stated on the flight plan. total_credits is the true sum 127 (base path). Course titles for coded courses are from the official AUM 2023-2024 Undergraduate Catalog course descriptions. The flight plan does not list prerequisites, so no prereq chains are seeded. Extraction note: the PDF text extraction appends unrelated Finance-plan content after the plan's final semester; only the Exercise Science content through Year Four Summer is seeded.
